questions.label: Who sends your natural gas bill?

programs.name: Xcel Energy cold-climate heat pump
programs.rules: Xcel's live page shows no amount. Its 2024 to 2026 rebate sheet lists $2,000 with Xcel gas and $1,500 with Xcel electric only. Participating contractor. Work invoiced by December 31, 2026.

programs.name: CenterPoint hybrid heat pump
programs.rules: Ducted heat pump added to a home with a gas furnace rated 92 percent or better. $400 in new construction.

programs.name: Minnesota Power cold-climate heat pump
programs.rules: $1,000 for a cold-climate ducted or ductless system, $400 for a standard one. Participating contractor.

programs.name: Rochester Public Utilities heat pump
programs.rules: Up to $2,200 for a large cold-climate unit that replaces working electric heat. $100 to $200 when replacing gas. Not more than half of the equipment cost.

programs.name: Minneapolis Green Cost Share
programs.rules: Up to $5,000 for all projects together, or up to $14,000 in a Green Zone. Single-family homes and buildings of up to four units inside Minneapolis.

programs.name: Xcel Energy electric panel upgrade
programs.rules: Covers the full project cost up to $1,500. The new panel must have more amps than the old one.

programs.name: Xcel Energy heat pump water heater
programs.rules: $400, or $500 for a smart model that can join demand management. Not for units over 80 gallons.

programs.name: Xcel Energy gas water heater
programs.rules: $75 for a tank, $250 for a tankless unit.

programs.name: CenterPoint gas water heater
programs.rules: Tank $250, tankless $500, combination unit $1,000, indirect tank $200.

programs.name: Minnesota Power heat pump water heater
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR certified model bought in 2026.

programs.name: Rochester Public Utilities heat pump water heater
programs.rules: 20 to 55 gallon ENERGY STAR model. Not more than half of the cost.

programs.name: Xcel Energy insulation and air sealing
programs.rules: 40 percent of cost: air sealing up to $600, attic up to $1,200, walls up to $1,200. Participating contractor and blower door tests.

programs.name: CenterPoint air sealing and insulation
programs.rules: Air sealing $750, with attic insulation $1,300, wall insulation $1,500, rim joist $200 as an add-on. Insulation alone earns nothing.

programs.name: Xcel Energy smart thermostat
programs.rules: For electric customers with central air conditioning. Xcel's page shows no amount, so we do not count it.

programs.name: CenterPoint thermostat
programs.rules: $50 for a smart or Wi-Fi model, $10 for a basic programmable one.

programs.name: Minnesota Power smart thermostat
programs.rules: Low-voltage Wi-Fi model where electricity is the main heat.

programs.name: Rochester Public Utilities smart thermostat
programs.rules: Half the price, up to $100 with electric heat, $50 with a heat pump, $10 with gas.

notes: Xcel Energy's heat pump and thermostat amounts could not be confirmed on a current page, so they are shown but never added to your total.

Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on the equipment and your final invoice. Solar is not included: Xcel's Solar*Rewards pays per kilowatt hour and we could not confirm its budget.
